message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "temporal_severity_quantification", "description": "When evaluating the evolution of chest pathology over time, explicitly quantify severity changes using a classifier on serial images rather than relying on visual estimation.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks involving the interpretation of multiple chest imaging studies (e.g., X-rays, CTs) taken at different time points to assess disease progression, resolution, or stability.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier"], "risk_level": "medium", "core_action": "When analyzing temporal chest imaging sequences to distinguish transient from persistent pathology: (1) Identify key timepoints (e.g., baseline, peak severity, current/resolution); (2) Invoke `chest_xray_classifier` on each selected image to obtain objective severity scores; (3) Compare the quantitative outputs to determine the trajectory (improving, worsening, stable) rather than relying on subjective visual comparison alone."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
